about: Machine-readable map of the 5G-MAG website: its projects, and the repositories behind them. Generated from the site's own data on every build; the pages it links to are the reference.

organisation.name: 5G-MAG
organisation.description: We bridge standards and deployments. We transform specifications into open-source software to boost deployability.

notes: access "early-access" means the repository is available to members first; the page of the project says how to request it.
standardsBodies names the bodies of the specifications a project or repository relates to; the exact specifications and versions are on the Specifications page of each project.

repositories.name: 5GMS Application Function (AF)
repositories.description: The 5GMS Application Function (AF) is a Network Function that forms part of the 5G Media Services framework as defined in ETSI TS 126.501.

repositories.name: 5GMS Application Server (AS)
repositories.description: The 5GMS Application Server (AS) is a Network Function that forms part of the 5G Media Streaming framework as defined in ETSI TS 126.501.

repositories.name: 5GMS-Aware Application
repositories.description: This repository holds applications that can be used to test and demonstrate other 5G-MAG Reference Tools related to 5GMS. Current applications available include: 5GMSd-Aware Application; Exo DVB-I Player.

repositories.name: 5GMS Media Session Handler
repositories.description: The 5GMS Media Session Handler is a 5GMS Client component that forms part of the 5G Media Services framework as defined in ETSI TS 126.501.

repositories.name: 5GMS Media Stream Handler
repositories.description: The 5GMS Media Stream Handler is a 5GMS client component that forms part of the 5G Media Services framework as defined in ETSI TS 126.501.

repositories.name: 5GMS Common Android Library
repositories.description: The 5GMS Common Library is an Android library that includes models and helper classes used within the different client-side Android applications such as the 5GMSd-Aware Application, 5GMSd Media Stream Handler and the 5GMSd Media Session Handler.

repositories.name: 5GMS Application Provider
repositories.description: This repository provides multiple tools to interact with the 5GMS Application Function: Command Line Interface Tool; Management UI; Postman Collection; QoE Metrics Reporting UI.

repositories.name: 5GMS Tools and Examples
repositories.description: This repository holds example projects that make use of other 5G-MAG repositories or provide additional functionalities to test and implement new features for 5GMS: 5G Media Streaming - Docker Compose Setup; Express Mock AF.

repositories.name: CMCD Toolkit
repositories.description: Tools to collect and analyse CMCD (Common Media Client Data) v2 locally and across different cloud providers.
projects: UE Data Collection, Reporting and Event Exposure
alsoUsedBy: UE Data Collection, Reporting and Event Exposure

repositories.name: Media Origin Server and Packager
repositories.description: A media origin server component for Content Delivery Protocols and Tools testing (JavaScript/TypeScript web application).

repositories.name: 5G Core Service Consumers
repositories.description: This repository contains a collection of reusable service consumer libraries designed to interact with the 5GC Network Functions using service interfaces.

repositories.name: CMMF Encoder
repositories.description: Reference implementation of a CMMF Encoder according to ETSI TS 103 973.

repositories.name: MBMS Modem
repositories.description: This repository holds an MBMS Modem, which main task is to convert a 5G BC input signal (received either as live I/Q raw data from the SDR or as prerecorded SDR sample file) to multicast IP packets on the output.

repositories.name: 5G Broadcast Transmitter
repositories.description: This repository holds a standalone 5G Broadcast transmitter.

repositories.name: MBMS Android Middleware
repositories.description: This repository holds an implementation of the MBMS Middleware for Android.

repositories.name: FLUTE Protocol and Profiles
repositories.description: This is an implementation of a FLUTE server and client.

repositories.name: MBMS Tools and Examples
repositories.description: This repository holds example projects that make use of other 5G-MAG repositories or provide additional functionalities to test and implement new features for MBMS: FLUTE ffmpeg.

repositories.name: 5G Broadcast Transmitter for QRD and CRD
repositories.description: This repository holds an extension of an MBMS-enabled eNodeB tailored to operate as a 5G Broadcast transmitter compatible with Qualcomm Reference Design (QRD) and QRC devices. In addition, System Information Blocks relevant for Emergency Alerts (e.g. SIB12) can be transmitted.

repositories.name: MBMS Client
repositories.description: MBMS client: reads the service announcement, reassembles FLUTE objects from the bearer, and republishes them to a local player as an HLS or DASH presentation. Supersedes rt-mbms-mw.

repositories.name: MBMS-Aware Application
repositories.description: Receive-side web application: plays what the MBMS client received over the air, and shows the modem's radio state, the decoded system information and any cell broadcast warning. Supersedes rt-wui.

repositories.name: 5G Broadcast Application Provider
repositories.description: Content provider portal: provisions xMB (TS 26.348) services and sessions on the BM-SC, and drives the transmitter's and MBMS Gateway's own control interfaces.

repositories.name: Broadcast-Multicast Service Center (BM-SC)
repositories.description: BM-SC for MBMS user services: ingests content over xMB (TS 26.348), announces it, and delivers it with FLUTE under the TS 26.346 profile.

repositories.name: MBMS Gateway
repositories.description: MBMS Gateway for an LTE-based 5G Terrestrial Broadcast deployment: takes content from the BM-SC and delivers it onto the M1-U bearer, driving the MBMS session lifecycle towards the MME over Sm (GTPv2-C).

repositories.name: MBMS Middleware
repositories.description: This repository holds the MBMS Middleware.

repositories.name: MBMS Web User Interface
repositories.description: A graphical web interface with a control display for the MBMS Modem and MBMS Middleware, with basic browser-based HLS playback of the manifest and segments provided by the middleware, using hls.js.

repositories.name: Cell Broadcast Centre (CBC)
repositories.description: Cell Broadcast Centre for the Public Warning System: accepts a warning message from an alert originator and emits it to the MME over SBc-AP, so it reaches handsets as ETWS or CMAS. Independent of any MBMS bearer.

repositories.name: XR Unity Player
repositories.description: The XR Unity Player is an interactive and XR-capable glTF scene viewer implemented in Unity3D. It supports glTF extensions specified in the MPEG-I Scene Description framework (ISO/IEC 23090-14).

repositories.name: MBS Client
repositories.description: UE-side MBS Client (3GPP TS 26.502): receives the MBS-4-MC announcement carousel and FLUTE object delivery, and exposes the received services to applications over the MBS-6 and MBS-7 local APIs.

repositories.name: MBS-Aware Application
repositories.description: Dashboard playing the MBS-Aware Application role (3GPP TS 26.502) against rt-mbs-client: lists announced services, activates and deactivates reception, and inspects received objects.

repositories.name: UE with support for MBS
repositories.description: 5G-MAG maintains a fork of srsRAN_4G, adapted for 5G Multicast Broadcast Services (MBS) support.

repositories.name: gNodeB with support for MBS
repositories.description: 5G-MAG maintains a fork of srsRAN Project, adapted for 5G Multicast Broadcast Services (MBS) support.

repositories.name: Generic 3GPP Data Collection AF
repositories.description: This repository provides a 5G Data Collection Service Provider library and AF. It can provide the interfaces R1-R6 as per 3GPP TS 26.531 (See Clause 4.2). The default Application Function implementation here implements some of the data reports and events defined in 3GPP TS 26.531, 3GPP TS 26.532 and 3GPP TS 29.517.

repositories.name: V3C Unity Player
repositories.description: This project provides a Unity package to decode and play V3C contents in Unity, using the MPEG V3C Immersive Platform - Decoder Plugin. Also provided in that repository are V-PCC and MIV synthesizers plugins needed for the rendering of the V3C contents.

repositories.name: V3C Decoder Plugin
repositories.description: This project contains the entrypoints for decoding and viewing MPEG Immersive Video (MIV) and Video Point Cloud Compression (V-PCC) related to the MPEG V3C Immersive Platform.

repositories.name: Content for V3C Immersive Platform
repositories.description: This folder contains the files to configure and test the V3CImmersivePlatform - Unity Player application.

repositories.name: V-DMC Web Decoder/Player

repositories.name: Beyond 2D Video Evaluation Framework
repositories.description: This project holds code related to the evaluation framework for the Feasibility Study on Beyond 2D Video (FS_Beyond2D) in 3GPP TSG SA WG4 (SA4). This study is based on work item description (WID) SP-240479 New SID on Feasibility Study on Beyond 2D Video, and the study will result in technical report TR 26.956.

repositories.name: 6G AI Traffic Characterization Testbed
